_comment: Posts that failed a voice rule on the day the rule was introduced (2026-10-08).
scripts/lint_post_voice.py reports these FAILs as LEGACY and does not fail the
run. The list only shrinks: if a listed rule stops failing for its post, the
lint fails until the entry is removed. Never add an entry to get a new or
rewritten post through; fix the text, or use a reviewed voice-allow comment.
Rewrites run the lint with --strict, which ignores this file.
Phase B rewrites (see .overhaul/REWRITE_PLAN.json) remove their post's entry.
